summary: Iteration 8 - branch geofencing, field staff, and editing employee name/email. Backend: 21/21 new pytest checks pass (test_geofence_branches.py). Covered: GET /attendance/geofence (field_staff, tolerance_m=50, branches); PATCH /admin/org/sites/{id} validation (radius 5/20000, lat sent without lng, lat=100, empty body -> 400; unknown id -> 404; sub-admin -> 403); setting a geofence and then clearing it; renaming a branch updates users.site and the managed_sites entries, and a duplicate name -> 400. Check-in/check-out: outside the circle -> 403 with the 'X m outside GeoTest HQ ... punch in/out' message; accuracy slack is capped at 50 m (blocked at 60 m past the edge with accuracy 1000; allowed at 35 m past the edge with accuracy 40); a punch inside ANY branch circle is allowed and check_in_branch/check_out_branch are stored; field staff can punch from anywhere; sub-admin field_staff out of scope -> 403; with no branch pinned, punches are allowed anywhere. Assignment endpoint: invalid email/duplicate email (case-insensitive)/blank name -> 400; email is lowercased; after an email change, login works with the new email and the old one returns 401; sub-admin editing someone out of scope -> 403. Regression: leave suites 41/43 pass. Of the 2 failures, one is intended behaviour (sub-admin may decide any leave) and one is a stale holiday-date conflict in the test data. Frontend (Playwright): Branches tab and status banner; adding a branch opens the edit modal automatically; the modal renders above the header; clicking the map drops a pin and shows coords; radius input and slider; rename + address + save -> row shows '350 M RADIUS' and the banner count updates; radius 5 shows a toast; Remove Geofence -> NOT PINNED; delete branch works. Sub-admin does not see the Branches tab. Org tab shows branches-moved-note and 'Branches' coverage chips. Team tab: 'Branch' label, branch filter, name/email edit with duplicate/invalid toasts, save and restore, field staff checkbox -> FIELD STAFF tag on/off. Live Map draws the dashed branch circle while an employee is on duty. Employee My Day: outside (12.99) -> toast 'You are 1846 m outside GeoTest HQ' and the zone line turns red, the camera does NOT open; inside (12.9720) -> 'Inside GeoTest HQ' and the face modal opens.

minor.issue: Changing an employee's email does not revoke their existing sessions or log anything beyond the activity log. That is acceptable, but if an email is reassigned for security reasons the old sessions stay valid.
managed_sites.$ positional update only replaces the first match per user (fine unless there are duplicates). Also there is no unique index on sites.name, so concurrent adds can race (low risk).

ui_bugs.issue: Nominatim place search failed in testing. The browser fetch to nominatim.openstreetmap.org was blocked by CORS because Nominatim returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited; a 429 response has no ACAO header). curl from the server also got 429. The UI shows a 'Search failed — click on the map instead' toast, so clicking on the map still works. Nominatim's usage policy requires an identifying User-Agent/Referer and is unreliable for direct browser use. Recommend proxying through the backend (/api/geocode with a proper User-Agent and caching) or switching to photon.komoot.io, with a fallback.
A sub-admin opening /admin#branches (or #org) gets a blank content area with no tab selected. It should fall back to the overview tab.

rca of the issue: Branch search: BranchEditModal calls fetch('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search...') straight from the browser. Nominatim rate-limits/blocks anonymous or shared-IP traffic with HTTP 429, and that error response has no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, so the browser reports a CORS error and the catch shows 'Search failed'. Mitigation: call it from the backend with a descriptive User-Agent and caching (respect 1 req/s), or use a geocoder that supports CORS.
